review_note.en: The theory and assessment loop is strong: problem sets 1–4 have solutions, while 5–6 do not, and multiple quiz and final sets include solutions. There is no full lecture-video series or public reproducible physical laboratory.

summary.zh: MIT 的《Photonic Materials and Devices》以四次设计评审和配套材料补充光子材料与器件学习；设计任务有价值，但没有答案且依赖付费教材。
summary.en: MIT's Photonic Materials and Devices supplements photonic materials and device study through four design reviews and supporting materials, while omitting answers and relying on a paid text.

review_note.zh: 四次设计评审很有价值，但没有答案，课程还引用付费的 Saleh 与 Teich 教材。
review_note.en: Four design reviews are valuable, but answers are absent and the course references the paid Saleh and Teich text.

summary.zh: IIT Kharagpur / NPTEL 的《Electrical Measurement and Electronic Instruments》以 84 个以上视频和演示提供电测量与电子仪器的开放理论主线；讲授面广，但没有可复现家庭实验、代码或答案闭环。
summary.en: IIT Kharagpur / NPTEL's Electrical Measurement and Electronic Instruments provides an open theory spine for measurement and instrumentation through more than eighty-four videos and demonstrations, while lacking a reproducible home lab, code, and answer loop.

review_note.zh: 84 个以上的视频与演示带来广泛覆盖，但没有可复现的家庭实验或编程闭环。
review_note.en: More than eighty-four videos and demonstrations provide broad coverage, but there is no reproducible home laboratory or coding loop.

summary.zh: IISER Bhopal / NPTEL 的《Sensor Technologies: Physics, Fabrication, and Circuits》以公开视频补充从传感器物理到制造与电路的广泛主题；没有开放的搭建测试或答案闭环，因此定位为理论补充。
summary.en: IISER Bhopal / NPTEL's Sensor Technologies: Physics, Fabrication, and Circuits supplements sensor study through a broad public video sequence spanning physics, fabrication, and circuits, but remains a theory companion because it has no open build-and-test or answer loop.

review_note.zh: 课程覆盖从传感器物理到电路的完整范围，但没有开放的搭建与测试闭环。
review_note.en: The course covers sensor physics through circuits but does not provide an open build-and-test loop.

summary.zh: University of Colorado Boulder 的《Sensors and Sensor Circuit Design》以 5 个模块、5 项作业、热敏电阻实验和课程项目构成有条件的传感器实践主线；实际材料与作业需要付费课程体验，实验还依赖 PSoC 5LP、配套器件、示波器和 Windows 工具链。
summary.en: University of Colorado Boulder's Sensors and Sensor Circuit Design forms an access-dependent practical sensor spine from five modules, five assignments, a thermistor laboratory, and a course project, while the actual materials and assignments require the paid course experience and the lab depends on a PSoC 5LP, supporting parts, an oscilloscope, and a Windows toolchain.

review_note.zh: 公开落地页列出 5 个模块、5 项作业、热敏电阻实验、课程项目及 PSoC 5LP/LCD/器件/示波器清单。实际材料与作业需要付费证书体验；平台可能提供试用，但不保证无证书访问。实验依赖较旧的 PSoC 5LP 与 Windows 工具链，因此本课是有条件实践主线，不是完全开放或硬件中立的课程。
review_note.en: The public landing page documents five modules, five assignments, a thermistor laboratory, a course project, and an explicit PSoC 5LP/LCD/components/oscilloscope bill of materials. The actual learning materials and assignments require the paid certificate experience (a trial may be offered and no-certificate access is not guaranteed), and the laboratory depends on an older PSoC 5LP and Windows toolchain. Treat this as an access-dependent practical spine, not a fully open or hardware-neutral course.

summary.zh: IIT Madras / NPTEL 的《Biomedical Instrumentation》以跨主题视频提供广泛入门；公开序列与十二周 syllabus 并非逐项对齐，也没有可复现仪器项目。
summary.en: IIT Madras / NPTEL's Biomedical Instrumentation provides a broad video-based introduction; the public lesson sequence does not map one-to-one to the twelve-week syllabus and offers no reproducible instrumentation project.

review_note.zh: Week 11–12 的激光、安全与监管主题没有清晰的一一对应视频；也无公开项目、实验、代码或答案。人体数据与身体接触式测量需要伦理审批和合格监督。
review_note.en: The lecture sequence is broad, but it does not provide a reproducible instrumentation project and must not be treated as authorization for diagnosis or human experimentation; human data or body-connected measurement requires ethics approval and qualified supervision.

summary.zh: MIT 的《Biomedical Signal and Image Processing》以多数讲义、实验和 MATLAB 工作流补充该方向；MRI、外科应用、随机信号 III 与总结等讲次没有 notes。
summary.en: MIT's Biomedical Signal and Image Processing supplements the field through most notes, labs, and a MATLAB workflow; lecture positions including MRI, surgical applications, Random Signals III, and wrap-up lack notes.

review_note.zh: 公开讲义不是完整逐讲集合；还应把 MATLAB 工作流与旧 MIT 数据链接迁移到 Python 和当前数据集。
review_note.en: The MATLAB workflow and old MIT-hosted data links should be migrated to Python and current datasets.

summary.zh: University of California, Berkeley 的《Analog Integrated Circuits》以 2025 年 21 份公开讲义、10 份作业、部分当前答案、历年已解考试、8 个实验和一项模拟 IC 设计项目构成高强度主线；课程从单级与差分放大器推进到稳定性补偿、偏置、折叠共栅、开关电容、ADC、比较器与噪声。
summary.en: University of California, Berkeley's Analog Integrated Circuits forms a demanding analog-IC spine from twenty-one public 2025 lecture decks, ten homework sets, partial current solutions, archived solved exams, eight laboratories, and a design project, progressing from single-stage and differential amplifiers through compensation, biasing, folded cascodes, switched capacitors, ADCs, comparators, and noise.

review_note.zh: 官方先修是 EE 105（现有课程 ID 31）。公开可运行的仿真仅包括 Lab 1 与旧 Lab 3 Part 1 的 LTspice 子集，其中 BJTopamp.asc 可直接下载；breadboard、仪器测量与 GSI 签字属于另一层台面作业。Lab 2、Lab 4–8 与项目依赖伯克利 Cadence/Virtuoso 服务器、SKY130 libraries 和校园评阅。Razavi 或 Gray 教材需付费，独立验证的 open-PDK 移植也不能写成原 Berkeley lab flow。
review_note.en: The official prerequisite is EE 105 (existing course ID 31). Publicly runnable simulation is limited to the LTspice portions of Lab 1 and old Lab 3 Part 1, including the downloadable BJTopamp.asc base circuit. Breadboard measurements, instrument readings, and GSI sign-off form a separate bench layer. Lab 2, Labs 4–8, and the project depend on Berkeley's Cadence/Virtuoso servers, SKY130 libraries, and campus review. The Razavi or Gray text is paid, and an independently validated open-PDK port must not be presented as the original Berkeley lab flow.
